title: Estates Authority Can't Adjudicate Proceedings Involving Deceased Party Without Legal Heirs Being Brought On Record: AP High Court
description: The Andhra Pradesh High Court has held that estates authority cannot continue and decide proceedings against deceased persons without their legal representatives being first brought on record, and that such proceedings are void and a nullity in law.
